Nitish kumar ke 20 sal ke karyakal par JDU ka dipotsav, patna se pure bihar men manaya ja raha sushasan divsa.
Sushasan divas karyakram men pahunche svasthy mantri nishant kumar ne News18 se khas batchit men kya kuchh kaha, sunie.
Man ki antim yatra men bhavuk hue purv CM arjun munda, parthiv sharir ko kandha dete dekh nam hueen logon ki aankhen.
